attempted_claim: Let N>=2, d>=2 over C. Let R^N_d be the space of regular polynomial endomorphisms f:P^N->P^N of degree d with totally invariant hyperplane H, with pi:R^N_d->M^{N-1}_d, [f]mapsto [f|_H]. Let X/C be an irreducible affine curve and sigma:X->R^N_d a morphism landing entirely in the postcritically finite locus, with pi o sigma constant. Is sigma constant? In particular for N=2 are the only positive-dimensional PCF families in R^2_d those that are Lattes at infinity?
